descriptions.notStarted: John Barricade is awaiting me at the Temple Hive! He's found something!
descriptions.inProgress: I spoke with John, and he's found a set of weird markings in the MesoGears that he can't decipher. He's mentioned that he'll need special crystals known as #bHyper Glyphs#k. I've agreed to snag #b50#k of them so he can decipher the markings. Electrophants...John thinks that the mechanism on their heads may have those Hyper Glyphs inside. I'd better be careful-I don't want to get shocked!
descriptions.completed: I got the #b50 Hyper Glyphs#k that John needed, and he's hard at work deciphering the markings. I should come back soon to see if he's finished!
